scope: Computer Control Phase 9B3B native file picker item selection and hierarchical directory expansion
platform: macOS Cocoa/AppKit NSOpenPanel via Provider registry and native Accessibility

prerequisiteEvidence.directoryDisclosureDiscoveryFinding: AXPress on FolderA AXDisclosureTriangle changed AXDisclosing false to true and exposed Nested.txt while picker location remained PickerRoot

safetyBoundary.addressing: registered application Providers and exact currently visible picker item names only
safetyBoundary.directoryExpansionTarget: exact visible directory row and its AXDisclosureTriangle advertising AXPress
safetyBoundary.postcondition: selection requires fresh selected=true observation; expansion requires independent fresh AXDisclosing=true observation while the picker remains open
safetyBoundary.cleanup: physical harness may stop only its temporary test-owned fixture process

expectedCoverage: filePicker.selectItem and filePicker.expandDirectory remain IMPLEMENTED until this session passes
obsolete filePicker.openDirectory is absent from runtime capabilities
a real NSOpenPanel opens on PickerRoot
Alpha.txt is selected through native AX semantics and independently observed selected=true
expandDirectory rejects Alpha.txt before native mutation because it is a file
the rejected file-as-directory operation preserves the open picker and PickerRoot location
FolderA is rebound by exact visible name and classified as a directory
directory expansion targets its AXDisclosureTriangle and invokes advertised AXPress only
success requires a separate fresh AXDisclosing=true observation
the picker remains open and location remains PickerRoot
Nested.txt becomes visibly observable after expansion
re-expanding FolderA is idempotent and preserves Nested.txt visibility
no picker accept/cancel, arbitrary path, filesystem mutation, AXConfirm, AXOpen, coordinate, keyboard, clipboard or synthetic double-click fallback is used
